summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Kuvira Sports. Backend pytest: 46/46 passed (100%) after minor test fixes. Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844) verified end-to-end: login (mock OTP 123456) -> onboarding -> home tabs, Discover facilities & facility detail with 'Book a Court' CTA, /marketplace, /community (feed loads with existing post + like), /create-game (form renders with facility/skill/format pickers), /ai-coach (video analysis screen), /profile (Admin sees 'Platform admin' entry -> Manage clubs, courts and operations), /admin route reachable as PLATFORM_ADMIN. Consumer flows (facilities, availability, bookings inc. 409 duplicate, games create/join inc. 409 capacity, community post+like, marketplace cart/order, AI Coach chat via /api/ai/coach/chat) all pass with real HTTP calls. RBAC verified: player -> 403 ORG_ACCESS_DENIED on /api/orgs/{id}/*; org-A owner cannot read org-B analytics; self-promotion via POST /api/admin/clubs by non-admin is 403 FORBIDDEN. No red screen, no 4xx/5xx on core screens.

minor.issue: Backend does NOT normalize Indian mobile to E.164; PLATFORM_ADMIN_MOBILES holds '+919999999999' so only clients sending +91-prefixed value get admin. Frontend does normalize, so real users work, but memory/test_credentials.md wording ('backend normalizes to +91') is misleading.
ROLE_PERMISSIONS map does not contain an explicit ROLE_PLAYER key (empty list). Consider adding PLAYER: [] so lookups don't KeyError.

issues: React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — cosmetic; likely from a react-native-* dependency.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Normalize mobile in /api/auth/otp/verify (10-digit -> +91XXXXXXXXXX) so PLATFORM_ADMIN_MOBILES matching is robust regardless of caller; then either format works.
OPTIONAL: Add ROLE_PLAYER: [] to ROLE_PERMISSIONS for symmetry.
OPTIONAL: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to clarify that the FRONTEND normalizes to +91 (backend takes value as-is).
OPTIONAL: Track down react-native-web 'pointerEvents' deprecation warning (likely in a UI lib) for a cleaner console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >600 lines; consider splitting auth/bookings/games/marketplace into routers (features.py + org_admin.py are already extracted, keep going).
OTP rate-limiter (429 'Too many OTP requests') fires quickly during automated testing — expected behavior for security; tests should use unique mobiles.
